pages.text: After lunch came nap time. After the nap, they would walk by the river.
Bobo really wanted to go on the river walk, but did not want to nap.
Bobo lay with eyes wide open. "I am not sleepy."
Bobo stood by the window and looked outside. Handprints dotted the glass.
Bobo played with blocks alone. The other children slept peacefully.
Nap time ended. The children put on shoes and gathered in the yard.
They walked toward the river in a line. Bobo sat down at the door, rubbing their eyes.
Teacher Bau spread a blanket beside Bobo. "A nap gives your legs their strength."
The next day, Bobo slept soundly under the blanket. On waking, their body felt light.
Bobo led the line. River water sparkled. Those legs strode ahead bravely.
